mobbin:ed6229f6-fa6d-413b-a6da-2edf7bb73.summary: User views KPI cards with Current/Previous/Average, opens Revenue ⋮ → Share, creates an expiring public snapshot link, then copies/opens or shares to X/LinkedIn.
steps: Dashboard — Revenue + Burn + Expenses cards; Customize; 3 months
Same cards with updated totals; card ⋮ affordance visible
Share metric modal — snapshot copy + Expires date + Create link
Link created — URL + open/copy + Expires date + Open in X / LinkedIn
steal: Per-metric Share from card ⋮, not whole-app export (step 2).
Explicit “chart is a snapshot in time” + Expires date before Create link (step 3).
After create: copy/open URL + visible expiry (step 4).
Current vs Previous vs Average legend on the shared metric card (steps 0–1).
avoid: Social Open in X / LinkedIn on the share modal (step 4) — irrelevant for dean/faculty digests.
mobbin:ed6229f6-fa6d-413b-a6da-2edf7bb73.fit: Best for time-boxed public dean digest links: per-KPI snapshot URL with expiry; lighter than live filterable shared dashboards.
